title: Bring a page forward
description: Bring a page's tab forward in its window and focus that window, for the rare step that needs the page on screen (a visual read that reports TAB_NOT_ACTIVE or WINDOW_NOT_FOCUSED, a control that only paints while visible).
guidance: No other page action activates a tab or focuses a window: dsagent.page.action and dsagent.page.actions drive a page in the background and leave the person's and other agents' tabs where they are. Allowed on a page opened for you, or on one of the person's pages you hold the lease on (the first agent acting on it keeps it for 90 s per action); another agent's page is refused POLICY_DENIED and its leased page TARGET_BUSY. Requires an idempotency key; repeating a key returns the first result.

pageContextId.description: Opaque page context from dsagent.pages.list, dsagent.page.open, or a receipt's destinationPageContextId.
The page that was brought forward.

active.description: Whether the tab is now the active tab of its window.

focused.description: Whether its window is now focused; false when the browser or OS refused focus, in which case the person has to click the window.

outputSchema.description: The page as it is after the call.
